revenue_resolution.publication_vintage: First publicly reported full-year consolidated actual, including an earnings release before the 10-K. Guidance, consensus, preliminary forecasts and later restatements are distinct. Retain the original release and reconcile the later filing separately.
revenue_resolution.selection: I will personally verify the consolidated statement, issuer, fiscal duration, accounting definition, unit and first-publication timestamp from issuer/SEC primary records. XBRL is a retrieval aid; no automated semantic labeler or LLM judge.
revenue_resolution.changes: If accounting tags or entity scope change, document the statement bridge and retain the original question. Do not silently switch to a convenient metric. If unresolved, keep the case unresolved rather than drop it.

returns.measure: adjusted-close total holding return, exit adjusted close / entry adjusted close - 1
returns.calendar_rule: Use first trading session on/after each specified date if closed. Resolve the actual sessions explicitly.
returns.benchmark: SPY, identical session endpoints and adjustment convention
returns.comparison: strict stock return > SPY return; ties resolve to false
returns.sources: Retain the dated adjusted-close series and corporate-action records. Personally cross-check endpoints/actions against issuer, exchange or primary distribution notices. Yahoo chart data may supply adjusted prices; it does not override a contradictory corporate-action record.
returns.delisting: Retain the case. Resolve cash/stock consideration, distributions and successor holdings through the exit date. Ordinary dividends before a terminal event follow the same adjusted-price total-return reinvestment convention as SPY. Cash merger consideration or liquidation proceeds after a terminal event are held without interest through exit. Bankruptcy or a missing quote does not automatically mean either zero or the last quote. Keep unresolved labels if primary records cannot establish the payoff.
returns.forecaster_target_errors: Score the original specified window even if the model used another entry date or trading-day count. Do not repair the prediction or move the target.

scoring.continuous: Absolute median error; pinball loss at .1/.5/.9; 80% interval coverage and interval score; weighted interval score. No pooling across revenue/return units.
scoring.binary: Brier score for outperforming SPY; constant .5 baseline has .25 Brier.
scoring.missing: All eight cases stay in coverage counts, including failed/late/missing predictions. Unresolved outcomes are pending, never fabricated.
scoring.hypotheses: Primary-agent personal assessment of the stated mechanism and falsifiers against later primary evidence, separately from price returns. No automatic prose grade and no other LLM judge.

evaluator_boundary: Resolution files live outside actor/ in evaluator/resolutions. The analyst has no tool or dataset exposing them.
clarification: Corporate-action mechanics clarified before any future target outcome exists; original question, fiscal revenue measure and return holding window remain as frozen in the actor manifest.
